description: Source code for DMA driver implementation for MPC55xx architecture, including initialization, configuration, start/stop, and status functions.

methods.name: Dma_Init
methods.description: Initializes DMA channels based on provided configuration.

methods.name: Dma_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes DMA channels by stopping all channels.

methods.name: Dma_ConfigureChannel
methods.description: Configures a specific DMA channel with a transfer descriptor.

methods.name: Dma_GetTcd
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the transfer control descriptor for a given channel.

methods.name: Dma_CheckConfig
methods.description: Checks if the DMA configuration is valid.

methods.name: Dma_ConfigureChannelTranferSize
methods.description: Sets the transfer size for a DMA channel.

methods.name: Dma_ConfigureChannelSourceCorr
methods.description: Configures source address correction for a DMA channel.

methods.name: Dma_ConfigureChannelDestinationCorr
methods.description: Configures destination address correction for a DMA channel.

methods.name: Dma_ConfigureDestinationAddress
methods.description: Sets the destination address for DMA transfer.

methods.name: Dma_ConfigureSourceAddress
methods.description: Sets the source address for DMA transfer.

methods.name: Dma_Active
methods.description: Returns whether a DMA channel is active.

methods.name: Dma_ClearInterrupt
methods.description: Clears the interrupt for a DMA channel.

methods.name: Dma_ChannelDone
methods.description: Checks if a DMA channel transfer is complete.
